items.title: Brent crude oil hits $98 after Iran's Houthi allies attack multiple Saudi energy facilities
items.description: Oil prices rose Tuesday on worries over escalating Mideast tensions after the U.S. and Iran traded strikes over the weekend.

items.title: Pharma major Novartis falls 10% after three drug trial setbacks
items.description: Shares of Novartis tanked on Tuesday after results from its del-desiran drug trial disappointed investors.

items.title: UK announces new Israeli settlement sanctions, despite U.S. warning of economic consequences
items.description: U.S. officials have warned the U.K. of potential economic consequences if it moves ahead with sanctions targeting Israeli settlements in the West Bank.

items.title: Here’s where rental demand is heading and what it means for future home sales
items.description: As U.S. rent prices rise, more tenants are relocating to cheaper markets, according to a new report by Zillow.

items.title: AstraZeneca's COPD drug scores two late-stage trial wins as full data boosts blockbuster hopes
items.description: The full data reinforces hopes that the drug could be a breakthrough COPD treatment and reach AstraZeneca's peak annual sales forecast of more than $5 billion.

items.title: Qualcomm issues Amazon warrants to acquire $4 billion worth of chipmaker's stock as part of AI infrastructure deal
items.description: Qualcomm is trying to move into the data center business, where Nvidia has been the dominant player in the AI boom.

items.title: U.S. sanctions Iranian airlines in aim to tighten economic squeeze as war spreads, oil rises
items.description: The latest U.S. action under "Operation Economic Outcast" targets all Iranian airlines that were not already facing sanctions.

items.title: 'Patients pay the tariff': Swiss pharma CEO warns of Trump's generic drug tariff threat
items.description: Sandoz CEO Richard Saynor warns steep U.S. tariffs on imported generic drugs could force manufacturers to raise prices or cut supply.

items.title: Australia targets algorithmic social feeds as it looks to hit Big Tech harder

items.title: Jim Cramer's top 10 things to watch in the stock market Tuesday
items.description: OpenAI's Astra model is generating a lot of buzz, and Intel shares are up almost 5% premarket.

items.description: U.S. President Donald Trump posted a stream of AI-generated images and a series of sweeping and unverified claims on Truth Social on Sunday

items.title: Iran Foreign Ministry takes aim at Canada for support of U.S. actions in Strait of Hormuz

items.title: Visa tells CNBC it is expanding data offering for blockchain lenders as demand for stablecoin-linked cards surges

items.title: TSMC, Samsung commit to ASML’s newest chipmaking tools as AI drives demand
